settings.deleteAllDataSubtitle: Permanently remove only this app's data saved on this device and in iCloud.
settings.deleteAllDataConfirmMessage: This cannot be undone. Only app-owned data saved by this app will be deleted from this device and iCloud where available. It will not delete Photos, Contacts, Files outside this app, or other apps' data.
settings.deleteAllDataSuccess: All app data has been deleted.
settings.deleteAllDataPendingCloud: Your local data was deleted. iCloud deletion will retry before sync resumes.
settings.deleteAllDataNoAccount: Your data on this device was deleted. iCloud isn't reachable right now — to remove iCloud data too, sign in to iCloud and delete again.
settings.deleteAllDataError: Deletion didn't finish — some data may remain. Please try again.
